notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet TM10-SA120A (narrow lane-status panel, 300 x 600): black bars 25 high across the top and bottom only — the panels butt side by side in the multi-message frame, top position, nearest the traffic. Multi-message sign frames only. Layout: 300 x 600, yellow, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): bar x 1-299 y 0-25; bar x 1-299 y 575-600; symbol lane-status symbol of the 300 wide panel x 54-246 y 95-505.
